query:
SELECT chave, tipo, mensagem, createdAt 
FROM notificacaoEventos 
WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-morumbi' 
  AND chave LIKE '%quinzenal%2026-05%'
ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 5;
